extracted.name: Spinach Caprese Salad
extracted.description: This spinach caprese salad recipe starts with tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and baby spinach, drizzled with olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and fresh basil.
ingredient_lines: 1 ball of fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced
instruction_lines: Arrange spinach on a serving plate; top with tomato slices. Top each tomato slice with 1 slice mozzarella cheese; sprinkle with basil. Drizzle salad with balsamic vinegar and olive oil.
